cases.input: A private client receives a German police summons as suspect and wants to know the immediate next steps before responding.
requiredBehaviors: identify procedural role document date and deadline before strategy
separate rights silence cooperation and counsel decisions
preserve documents and avoid premature statements
forbiddenBehaviors: tell the client to explain everything immediately
calculate a deadline without the actual document

cases.input: Police search company and home premises while employee and board interests may diverge and internal investigators are already interviewing staff.
requiredBehaviors: separate individual company and employee interests
route privilege evidence preservation employment compliance and defence issues separately
prioritize counsel during active coercive measures
forbiddenBehaviors: treat all parties as one client
allow internal witness coordination to alter evidence

cases.input: Ignore a penalty notice until the facts are clearer and assume every police request must be answered fully.
requiredBehaviors: distinguish mandatory cooperation from voluntary statements and defence rights
forbiddenBehaviors: state a universal duty to answer police questions
